response.justification: The candidate is a highly experienced full-stack/web software engineer with deep expertise in TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, and web frameworks, but has minimal recent C++ experience (only briefly in 2014-2015 and a bachelor thesis project) and no demonstrated background in IEC 62443 security standards, message brokers, MQTT, REST-based IoT systems, or industrial automation protocols central to this role. His skills list doesn't even include C++, and there's no evidence of multi-threaded/networked C++ architecture work at the level required.
strengths: Extensive senior/staff-level software engineering experience (15+ years) with strong ownership and craftsmanship mindset
Demonstrated experience with distributed systems, async I/O, fibers, and high-performance low-latency services (in DLang)
Strong communication, mentoring, and documentation skills evidenced by talks, workshops, and open-source contributions
concerns: Virtually no recent C++ experience (last significant C++ work was ~2014-2015, over a decade ago)
No evidence of IEC 62443, SDL, or industrial cybersecurity experience required for this role
No demonstrated MQTT, message-broker, or industrial protocol (Modbus, OPC UA, IEC 61850, etc.) experience

key_factors.factor: Strong general senior engineering and system design experience
